I contribute towards open and citizen science resources and enjoy communicating my research to a broad audience. ::: {.online-grid} ::: {.online-card .inaturalist} ### iNaturalist I contribute observations and taxonomic identifications to the iNaturalist. [View profile →](https://www.inaturalist.org/people/fvaux) ::: ::: {.online-card .wikipedia} ### Wikipedia I do some editing on Wikipedia, focusing on sharing scientific knowledge so that it is free and widely accessible. [View user page →](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:IcknieldRidgeway) ::: ::: {.online-card .phylopic} ### PhyloPic I upload illustrations to PhyloPic, which is a free, open database of silhouette images for biological organisms. [View contributions →](https://www.phylopic.org/contributors/9238892b-6eb7-471b-8bbf-a4092c19a2b4/felix-vaux-silhouettes) ::: ::: {.online-card .bionomia} ### Bionomia Some of my contributions to natural history collections and other databases are recorded on Bionomia. [View profile →](https://bionomia.net/0000-0002-2882-7996) ::: ::: {.online-card .bluesky} ### Bluesky I post sporadically on Bluesky, mainly sharing studies and news related to evolutionary ecology and genomics. [View profile →](https://bsky.app/profile/felixvaux.bsky.social) ::: ::: {.online-card .youtube} ### YouTube I occasionally post work-related videos like presentations or methods walkthroughs on YouTube.
